name: copy-button
description: A source-owned Dioxus-only Copy Button for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `ADICO_ONLY_EXTRA`, no upstream counterpart in any of statics/catalogs/{shadcn,base-ui,dioxus-components,dioxus-primitives}.json. Composes the installed `button` item for its surface and `adico-primitives`'s target-gated `clipboard::use_clipboard` hook for the actual copy -- the browser clipboard API call stays behind that primitive adapter (this repo's architecture rule), never called directly from this file. On the `web` target it copies via `navigator.clipboard.writeText`; every other target resolves to a failed status rather than pretending to succeed, since no native clipboard integration exists in this workspace yet.
documentation.accessibility: No dedicated APG pattern for clipboard copying; renders a native `<button>` (via the installed `button` item) with an `aria-label` reflecting idle/copied/failed state, so the outcome of activating it is announced even though the visual change is only an icon swap.
documentation.keyboard: Native button keyboard behavior only (Enter/Space activates); no custom keyboard layer.
